payload.claim: The docstring asserts `tree` is 'omitted (as every caller but the one that supplies it does today)', implying a production caller already supplies it. No such caller exists: `saffron/cell/session.py:966`, `saffron/phases/package.py:520` and `saffron/replay.py:164` all call `run_suite`/`runner.run_suite` without `tree=`; only the new `tests/test_gates.py` does. The comment documents a wiring that was never made, which will mislead the next reader into believing `witness` is already live somewhere.
